topic: Phases of the Moon and their characteristics
key_concepts: The moon is Earth's only natural satellite
The moon does not produce its own light but reflects sunlight
The changing visible shape of the moon is called phases of the moon
The moon's phases change as it orbits Earth
The eight moon phases are new moon, waxing crescent, first quarter, waxing gibbous, full m
During a new moon, the moon is between the sun and Earth and its lighted side faces away f
During a full moon, Earth is between the sun and moon and the moon's lighted side faces Ea
Waxing means the visible lighted part of the moon appears to grow
Waning means the visible lighted part of the moon appears to shrink
The moon is about one-fourth the size of Earth
The moon has no air and no water
The moon revolves around Earth about once every 27 days, 7 hours, and 43 minutes
